llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.support
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.support.runtime
role Supply injectable clock, process identity, randomness, sleep, environment, and liveness probes for deterministic tests.
owns runtime injection, deterministic identity, process liveness
excludes filesystem access, generation policy

@llmnav.support.abort
role Expose cooperative cancellation checks so long scans, queries, and generations can stop at bounded checkpoints.
owns abort checks, abort error normalization
excludes cancellation sources, retry policy
